== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* First reached challenger on the Chinese server at the age of 12.
* Is the son of Xiang Ben-Mi (向本密), one of the founders and shareholder of the restaurant chain '''Hutaoli Music Restaurant & Bar''' in China.
=== Statistics ===
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on June 10, 2022.
** The 31st player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on July 15, 2024.
** The 24th player to reach 1500 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on February 11, 2025
** The 27th player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on May 10, 2025.
** Was the 37th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.

===Individual Awards===
* LPL 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (Spring 2024)
